description: This file defines the UtilObject class in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package, providing utility methods for object serialization, deserialization, size calculation, hash code computation, and factory-based object creation.

classes.name: UtilObject
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for object serialization, deserialization, size measurement, hash code calculation, and factory-based object creation.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Serializes an object into a byte array.

methods.name: getByteCount
methods.description: Computes the size in bytes of a serialized object.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array back into an object, logging errors if deserialization fails.

methods.name: getObjectException
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into an object, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: doHashCode
methods.description: Calculates a hash code for an object, including array contents.

methods.name: getObjectFromFactory
methods.description: Creates an object instance via a service loader that implements a specific factory interface.
